reviews.classification: complete historical start/multiworld dispatch or local UI palette
reviews.disposition: The complete13-line index-lane prompt is historical dispatch. Its rounds1–16 family census, brief user quotes, proposed defaults, contradiction flags, dev-probe evidence and ranked candidates were an index assignment, not a new start algorithm. The owner's later B303 reconciliation already preserves its actual194-line reading, source/probe limits and later launch notices. “Read linked outputs” here does not credit this reconciliation with reading their bodies. Current [world-entry rules](WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md), [lead-life scope](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), AD23/AD51/AD52 and actual user direction control selected starts. The old requirement to flag contradictions without resolving them applied to that lane; it does not prevent current owner reconciliation from applying later explicit direction. No new role selection, random roll, dossier pass, start implementation or dispatch follows from this prompt.
reviews.evidence: Complete13/14/17/19-line input bodies read. Existing output-owner final reconciliation sections inspected for routing only; linked source/dossier/probe/UI evidence not newly read or executed.
reviews.reopen: Use current selected start/world/task and actual source/consumer evidence. Preserve old suggestions and scopes without replaying dispatch.

reviews.classification: complete historical start/multiworld dispatch or local UI palette
reviews.disposition: The complete14-line ideas-lane prompt requested qualified dossier comparison and original possibilities, not primary-book qualification or gameplay implementation. Its requested private paths and source labels are historical dependencies. The later B310 owner reconciliation retains all actual source cutoffs, absent notes, identity/intent/role distinctions and the unimplemented minimal-state sketches. Reading this prompt did not read any private brief, synthesis, chapter or sealed truth. VX/OX possibilities remain available palettes; no inherited title decides the present person's intent, and no copied-memory label alone decides continuity or information sharing. Current [world-entry rules](../WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md), [lead-life rules](../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and AD32 govern an actual selected consumer. Do not replay the old dossier assignment or treat suggestions as a new queue.

reviews.classification: complete historical start/multiworld dispatch or local UI palette
reviews.disposition: The complete17-line multiworld audit prompt was read. Its five-SHOWN/five-INFERRED per-lane spot-check target is the original audit requirement, not proof the checks were performed by reading this prompt. The report's ten MWA packets map to existing K/P owners; they are proposals, not ten adopted mechanics. The original nested-world root path is stale as this report already records; the dispatch owner supplies the route. Old installing/not-installed statements, owner labels, next-slice ranking and1366×768 gate remain dated. Use current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../UI_RULES.md), [architecture](../../ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) and exact source-qualified world laws for a selected consumer. Carrying a method, useful foreign operation, relationship continuity and differing world rules need their actual evidence; neither a premise comparison nor a world name proves them. No source game/site, audit sample, private payload, install, UI/browser or current module was rechecked here; source-lane checks and their remaining gaps stay with their original receipts.

reviews.classification: complete historical start/multiworld dispatch or local UI palette
reviews.disposition: All19 original lines were reviewed. Preserve the observed patrol-card duplication and unrelated-content ordering concern as October11 screenshot/source observations. People/Work/Projects categories, one next-action layout and a single ordering coordinator were prototype choices, not current mandatory navigation or a reason to replace actual module/content ownership. Current [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md) UR1–5/35/53/57/70–74 and [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) govern task composition, desktop targets and observer-safe disclosure. Keep useful known alternatives, actual costs/irreversibility, timer/cancellation/debt, stable selection/scroll/focus and truthful blocked/started/settled feedback reachable through the chosen task. A layout disclosure is distinct from a gameplay command or save writer. This file's proposed prototype gate is not a passed rendered journey, current confirmed bug or current requirement for those exact categories. No screenshots, live source, browser layout, code, save or accessibility behavior was newly checked.
